attested_at_note: The estimator was not retrained by this tool. Hyper-parameters, input count and class ordering are read from the artifact itself; the dataset digest is recomputed from the documented generator; metrics are copied from the existing *_metrics.json and flagged as reported, not re-measured.
limitations: Reported metrics are measured on a synthetic hold-out whose labels are derived from the scenario generator's own signatures. Perfect synthetic accuracy does not establish real-world generalization and must not be quoted as production detection performance.
